close_reason: Duplicate of stoa-owq35.18 (reqwest::Client rebuilt per fetch_url call).
description: mta_sts_fetcher.rs:fetch_url constructs a new reqwest::Client on every invocation, which includes populating the WebPKI root cert store and initializing TLS state. At high delivery volume (many distinct domains), this runs on every cache miss. reqwest::Client is designed to be cloned/shared; the correct pattern is to build it once (e.g. as a parameter to fetch_mta_sts_policy_body or held in MtaStsEnforcer) and reuse it. Expected impact at scale: O(distinct-domain-cache-misses) × root-store-init cost.
title: fetch_url builds a new reqwest::Client per policy fetch (expensive)
